annotations.text:
BUILT AND RUNNING
This mirrors the shipping plugin, not a mockup. Chakra Petch for the wordmark and labels, JetBrains Mono for numerics - both embedded in the binary.

EIGHT CONTROLS, THREE TIERS
Large 116px: LENGTH, DUCK, AMOUNT - the ones you reach for.
Medium 86px: TONE, DRIVE, RELEASE.
Small 66px, dimmed: SPACE, HPF - set and forget.
Grouped TAIL / FILTER / DUCK / OUTPUT, which is signal order.

THE DISPLAY
Real scope data off the engine, not a graphic. Orange is the ducked output, the dashed line is the raw tail before ducking - the gap between them is the duck doing its work.
Royal Rumble is a live WWE trademark. Fine for a personal tool, not a name this could be released under. No WWE assets are used anywhere - only the wordmark would need to change.
